stages.objective: First externally sourced pretraining corpus slice with exact provenance and fail-closed eligibility.
acceptance: Every admitted source has immutable source_id/source_version, snapshot URI, byte size, SHA-256 and retrieval metadata.
Every admitted source has a durable rights decision explicitly allowing model training; NOASSERTION and REVIEW_REQUIRED remain ineligible.
D06 benchmark registry is translated into the D03 reserved registry with exact manifest identity and contamination injection tests pass.
Quality, language, PII and copyright hooks emit versioned evidence; non-PASS hook states remain ineligible.
Deterministic shard and resume manifests rebuild byte-identically from the same identities and inputs.
AUDIT-B reviews the exact corpus manifest; this backlog cannot self-promote the corpus.
evidence_now: PR #38 exact head ff39bf9285a1c59458a848a4e52d13135d76248b has completed CI success run 32646727768.
Current external source and reserved registries are intentionally empty; zero external source is approved.

stages.objective: Scalable Parquet/fsspec ingestion and exact/near dedup execution on reviewed sources.
acceptance: DataTrove runtime version is hash/version locked by the execution environment and matches the validated plan.
Parquet staging uses deterministic partition identity and task-completion/resume evidence.
Exact dedup is content-fingerprint based; near dedup uses a maintained MinHash implementation with recorded thresholds/configuration.
A synthetic or approved-source scale test records throughput, peak memory, shard skew and restart behavior without overclaiming production capacity.
Remote fsspec/object-store reads and writes are verified against immutable snapshot hashes.

stages.objective: Multilingual quality and policy calibration with decontamination evidence beyond exact overlap.
acceptance: Language-identification quality is measured on a labeled multilingual fixture and error rates are recorded by language/script.
Quality filters have versioned calibration evidence and rejection samples; thresholds are not changed silently.
PII and copyright-policy hooks have explicit review/escalation states and retained evidence hashes.
Near-duplicate contamination evaluation includes injected benchmark paraphrase/overlap fixtures and records false-positive/false-negative behavior.
Train/validation/test identities remain isolated across source IDs, exact content fingerprints and configured near-duplicate policy.

stages.objective: Auditable corpus freeze candidate for larger Base pretraining.
acceptance: Corpus manifest binds every source version, snapshot hash, policy-evidence hash, dedup/decontamination plan, shard artifact hash and tokenizer handoff identity.
A clean rebuild from immutable snapshots reproduces manifest/shard identities or differences are fully explained and versioned.
D04 consumes the exact frozen corpus identity without silently reshuffling held-out material.
D06 contamination registry and evaluation identities are bound to the same freeze cutoff.
D10 release/candidate evidence references the exact corpus manifest and AUDIT-B independently adjudicates it.
